description: Claim a window on one resource. The hold is what makes the window unavailable to everybody else, and it expires by itself if nobody pays — so holding is safe, and a hold nobody confirms costs nothing. `startAt` must be exactly a slot start from get_booking_availability, and `endAt` exactly where the last slot ends; anything else is refused rather than rounded. A refusal with 409 means somebody took it first: re-read availability and offer what is left, do not retry the same window.

customerId.description: Who it is for, id from get_customers. Omit for a walk-in nobody identified

endAt.description: ISO instant, exactly where the booked window ends

outletId.description: The shop the sale happens at

resourceId.description: Which resource — the barber, room or asset being booked

startAt.description: ISO instant, exactly a slot start from availability

name: hub_hold_booking
title: Hold a booking window
